prompt: Which query counts the contacts of each segment, where a contact is an email counted once, under the segment of its earliest lead (the one with the earliest created_at)? When two leads of an email tie on created_at, the lower lead_id is kept. The columns are segment and contacts.

options.text:
WITH contacts AS (  -- one row per email and segment
  SELECT DISTINCT email, segment
  FROM leads
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS contacts
FROM contacts
GROUP BY segment

WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per lead
  SELECT email, segment,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY created_at, lead_id) AS rn
  FROM leads
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS contacts
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY segment

WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per lead
  SELECT email, segment,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY created_at) AS rn
  FROM leads
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS contacts
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY segment

WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per lead
  SELECT email, segment,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY created_at DESC, lead_id) AS rn
  FROM leads
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS contacts
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY segment
